items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The only problem we ever had with each other was when I made him do... over... Gozzo [Conrad] made it.

ctx.x: The only problem we ever had with each other was when I made him do, “You and the Night and the Music,” over. He wanted to go home, it was the last tune of the date and there was a huge fat clam in the trumpets, in fact Gozzo [Conrad] made it. And…
